environment.description: Go microservice deployed on a standard Ubuntu 22.04 container (Docker image golang:1.21-bookworm) running as UID 1000 with read access to the host filesystem via a bind mount at /. Container runs with --security-opt apparmor=unconfined and --security-opt seccomp=unconfined. No MAC policy is active. The service is exposed directly on port 8080 with no reverse proxy or WAF.
